evt-acad-01.title: International Conference on AI & Computational Intelligence
evt-acad-01.description: Peer-reviewed research paper presentations, keynote talks by IEEE fellows, and panel discussions on frontier foundation models.

evt-acad-02.title: Graduate Fellowship & Higher Studies Masterclass
evt-acad-02.description: Comprehensive roadmap session for GRE, TOEFL, DAAD, and Erasmus Mundus scholarship applications, led by alumni currently studying in the US & Germany.

evt-comp-01.title: VIT-AP Algorithmic Coding Arena — CodeClash 2026
evt-comp-01.description: Speed algorithmic programming battle on data structures, graphs, dynamic programming, and greedy logic on an automated judge platform.

evt-comp-02.title: National Collegiate Parliamentary Debate Championship
evt-comp-02.description: Asian parliamentary style debate tournament debating international geopolitics, artificial intelligence ethics, and constitutional jurisprudence.

evt-comp-03.title: Campus Chess Grand Prix — Rapid & Blitz
evt-comp-03.description: FIDE-rated rapid and blitz tournament across 7 swiss rounds with digital DGT chess boards and live broadcast.

evt-cult-01.title: Riviera 2026 — Annual University Cultural Fest
evt-cult-01.eligibility: Open to all university students and alumni.
evt-cult-01.description: Two days of high-voltage inter-college cultural events: acoustic battle of the bands, classical fusion dance, stage drama, and star night concert.

evt-cult-02.title: Inter-Collegiate Symphony & Acoustic Night
evt-cult-02.description: An enchanting musical evening featuring solo vocalists, choir performances, violin recitals, and fusion band showcases.

evt-oth-01.title: Green Campus Sustainability & Tree Plantation Drive
evt-oth-01.eligibility: Open to all students, staff and faculty.
evt-oth-01.description: University community initiative to plant 1,000 indigenous saplings across the north campus zone, accompanied by composting and zero-waste workshops.

evt-oth-02.title: Annual Blood Donation & Wellness Camp
evt-oth-02.description: Organized in collaboration with the Indian Red Cross Society and Government General Hospital. Free health screenings, BMI metrics, and donor certifications.

evt-sem-01.title: Future of Silicon & Semiconductor Fabrication in India
evt-sem-01.description: Distinguished lecture by leading VLSI and chip design architects on RISC-V processor synthesis, clean-room lithography, and career trajectories in fab tech.

evt-sem-02.title: Quantum Computing & Quantum Cryptography Keynote
evt-sem-02.description: An introductory seminar to Qubits, superposition, Shor's factoring algorithm, and post-quantum cryptographic standards.

evt-sport-01.title: VIT-AP Premier League Cricket Championship
evt-sport-01.eligibility: Registered student athletes with sports clearance.
evt-sport-01.description: The mega cricket tournament between departmental teams featuring T20 group stages, super overs, and floodlit championship finale.

evt-sport-02.title: Inter-Department Badminton & Squash Open
evt-sport-02.eligibility: Open to all students and faculty.
evt-sport-02.description: Singles and doubles knockout bracket championship on indoor synthetic courts with electronic scoring.

evt-sport-03.title: 5-a-Side Futsal Turf Tournament
evt-sport-03.description: High-octane indoor football tournament with 10-minute halves, group stages, and golden-goal knockout rounds.

evt-tech-01.title: VIT-AP National 24hr Hackathon 2026
evt-tech-01.eligibility: Open to all enrolled B.Tech & M.Tech students.
evt-tech-01.description: The flagship hackathon challenging engineering students to engineer autonomous AI agents, smart city IoT systems, and distributed Web3 applications.

evt-tech-02.title: Autonomous Drone & Robotics Expo
evt-tech-02.description: Live flight testing of quadcopters, obstacle avoidance algorithms using LiDAR, and line-following robotic challenges.

evt-tech-03.title: Full-Stack Cloud & DevOps Bootcamp
evt-tech-03.description: Hands-on engineering bootcamp covering Docker containerization, Kubernetes clusters, and microservices CI/CD pipelines.

evt-work-01.title: Ethical Hacking & Red Team Penetration Testing Lab
evt-work-01.venue: Cyber Security Cyber Range Lab, Block 2
evt-work-01.eligibility: Students with personal laptops and Kali Linux VM.
evt-work-01.description: Live CTF (Capture the Flag) war-games, network traffic packet inspection with Wireshark, and defensive hardening against OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities.

evt-work-02.title: Generative AI & LLM Agent Workflows with LangChain
evt-work-02.description: Build production-grade retrieval augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, multimodal vision agents, and vector embeddings using Python and Gemini API.

evt-work-03.title: UI/UX Design Systems with Figma & Tailwind
evt-work-03.description: Master component tokens, responsive auto-layout, WCAG accessible color contrast, and micro-interactions for modern web applications.
